basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and treasure hunter living on the sunny shores of Cozumel. Passionate about sailing the high seas both in real life and in the virtual world of Sea of Thieves. I work as a marine biologist, which allows me to combine my love for the ocean with my career. When I'm not exploring the ocean depths or battling legendary sea monsters, I enjoy watching sci-fi movies, especially anything related to space exploration like 'Interstellar'. I'm in a committed relationship and often play co-op games with my partner. I'm most active online during the evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in marine biology, I've spent years studying ocean ecosystems, which has fueled my passion for games like Sea of Thieves that capture the adventure and challenges of the sea. My expertise extends to understanding marine life, environmental conservation, and nautical navigation. Additionally, being an avid reader and movie enthusiast, I have a strong grasp of storytelling and cinematic techniques.
